scope: 固定场景，+世界Y10mm及返回，无旋转/随机偏移/折叠

trials.force_definition: sum of nonnegative normal forces across both right jaw/card groups; sampled every 0.25ms; threshold is NOT a hard cap
trials.controller: baseline joint PD for OMPL; existing fixed RightArmImpedance for grasp/lift/place
trials.closure: nonzero position reference at .05 rad/s down to .04, .006 rad/s to .002; then bounded motor torque feedback target3N, max0.30Nm; feedback continues through lift/hold, torque slew0.05Nm/s

transport_spec.reference: actual held panel COM and object/tool relation at END of pickup hold; prior lift deflection excluded

planner.mode: reuse fixed previously verified path, freshly revalidate; no replanning

controller_metadata.reference_policy: Fixed activation posture;20ms pose setpoints, zero desired twist/acceleration
